results.title: PI Impact: Purposely doing good
results.content: Mentha Impact supports purpose-driven companies that address global environmental challenges. Environmental impact Pymwymic invests in pioneering individuals that are building fairer and sustainable food chains. Borski Fund invests in companies that reduce the gender gap. Groundwork BioAg is a bio platform for regenerative agriculture. Carbon Equity invests in expert-selected and professionally managed climate funds. J-Impact invests in companies that are dedicated to solving the critical social and environmental challenges. Impact and value shouldn’t be a trade-off. In fact, we believe that impact drives value. We look for the possibility of changing the world for good, therefore the impact you’re making should be clear and measurable. To effectively make impact, your solution should be sustainable and scalable with a large market potential.

results.title: Operating Partners Human Capital Forum 2026 - PEI Events
results.content: This event is built exclusively for private equity operating partners and value creation teams, especially those involved in human capital, talent strategy, organizational design, or value creation planning. Elizabeth is an Operations VP, Human Capital at Trive Capital, where her responsibilities include partnering with investment and management teams to develop and execute human capital strategies and projects in support of Trive’s portfolio companies. She partners with portfolio company management teams to develop human capital strategies that drive value creation and manages the fund’s executive network. John Knapp is an Operating Director and Talent Specialist in Berkshire Partners’ Portfolio Support Group, where he focuses on talent leadership and human capital best practices across the portfolio. Prior to joining Clearlake, Karina co-led Human Capital Practice at Advent International where she focused on Human Capital Management across Advent’s portfolio companies, including leadership assessment, and growing network of top senior executives for CXO, Board, and Operating Partner, and Advisor roles.
